svg.title: Qm13 Wigner Negativity
svg.desc: What this figure shows: Qm13 Wigner Negativity. Visible guideposts include: −3; −2; −1; 0; 1; 2; 3. How to read it: use the explicitly printed labels, arrows, axes, panels, regions, and legends; do not assign meaning from color, proximity, or shape unless the figure says so. Main takeaway: this visual organizes a declared mathematical, physical, statistical, or research-architecture relationship and should be read with its linked context. Scientific status: Conceptual or architecture figure; formal conclusions require the linked research context.
